description: Convention proposal: default to bun as the JS/TS runtime across all zgent repos. Rationale: (1) stable system path (/usr/local/bin/bun) eliminates nvm shim failures in automation contexts (MCP launchers, hooks, CI), (2) faster startup for MCP servers and CLI tools, (3) drop-in compatible for 95%+ of enterprise usage. Carve-out: keep node available via nvm for packages requiring native addons or Node-specific APIs — pin and document those exceptions. Immediate trigger: bare 'node' in MCP configs silently fails because Claude Code's MCP launcher doesn't source shell profiles. Scope: update MCP configs, CLI scripts, and CLAUDE.md conventions across all repos. Assignee: COO.
